 /**
  * Number of pages needed to display `total` items at `pageSize` per page.
  *
- * BUG: a partial final page is dropped, so 7 items at 3 per page report 2
- * pages instead of 3 and the last page is never requested.
  */
 export function pageCount(total, pageSize) {
   if (pageSize <= 0) throw new RangeError('pageSize must be greater than zero');
   if (total <= 0) return 0;
-  return Math.floor(total / pageSize);
+  return Math.ceil(total / pageSize);
 }
 
 /**
  * The items on a 1-based `page`.
  *
- * BUG: the end offset is one item short, so every page returns pageSize - 1
- * items and one item per page is never shown.
  */
 export function paginate(items, page, pageSize) {
   if (pageSize <= 0) throw new RangeError('pageSize must be greater than zero');
   if (page < 1) throw new RangeError('page is 1-based');
   const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
-  return items.slice(start, start + pageSize - 1);
+  return items.slice(start, start + pageSize);
 }

payload.text:
Fixed the pagination off-by-one errors in [src/pagination.js](/private/var/folders/wz/1j18wyv50vb_g1hlhd5zz_yw0000gn/T/tmp.xN3o2UpVhK/state-codex/workspaces/01a07bf5-7769-70c5-9a94-123f82562ef4/01a07bf5-7769-70c6-8810-15ccc63f63ab/01a07bf5-7769-70c7-a88a-162aa9fdd57a/src/pagination.js:8):

- `pageCount()` now uses ceiling division, so 7 results at 3 per page produces 3 pages.
- `paginate()` now uses the correct exclusive slice endpoint, returning up to `pageSize` items.

Verification:

- `node --test test/`: 5 passed, 0 failed
- `npm test`: 5 passed, 0 failed
- `git diff --check`: passed
- Only `src/pagination.js` was modified.
